headline: RV Level Three
title: RV Level 3 | Eleven workers | Aniimo Guide
video_script: RV level three is the next big Homeland step in Aniimo. It lifts your worker limit from eight to eleven. You need six farmland plots and three woodland plots, plus the Together with Aniimo quest. It also opens the Ecological Module, according to one guide. Build your woodlands early and assign workers to them. What RV level are you on? Comment below!
description: Aniimo RV level 3 requirements: six farmland plots, three woodland plots and the Together with Aniimo quest raise the worker limit to eleven.
